qa_pairs.question: What are the storage quotas for the $HOME, $SCRATCH, and $PROJECT filesystems on the Vulcan cluster for different user categories?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Vulcan cluster, the $HOME filesystem has a fixed quota of 50 GB per user. For $SCRATCH, all user categories, including CIFAR AI Chairs, AI Institute Faculty Affiliates, and all Faculty members, receive 5 TB per user. This $SCRATCH space has an expiration time of 2 months. For the $PROJECT filesystem, CIFAR AI Chairs are allocated 12.5 TB, AI Institute Faculty Affiliates get 10 TB, Faculty members within an AI program receive 7.5 TB, and Faculty members applying AI to other domains are allocated 5 TB.

qa_pairs.question: What is the backup and recovery policy for the home and project spaces on the Vulcan cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Vulcan cluster, the home and project spaces have a backup policy of nightly backups, which are retained for 30 days. Additionally, deleted files from these spaces are retained for a further 60 days. To recover a previous version of a file or directory, users should contact technical support with the full path of the file(s) and the desired version by date. It's important to note that this policy is distinct from any purging age limits applied to the scratch space.
